definitions.explanation: An informal or affectionate name used instead of one's real name, typically by friends, family, or within a specific community. In Japanese, ニックネーム most commonly refers to the display name used on websites, apps, and games, as well as nicknames given among classmates or friends.

examples.japanese: ニックネーム⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{呼|よ}んで→呼ぶ：00766_yobu⟧。
⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧ニックネーム⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧「タック」だ。
⟦{登録|とうろく}する→登録する：25227_tourokusuru⟧とき⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{好|す}き→好き：02355_suki⟧なニックネーム⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{入力|にゅうりょく}して→入力する：28127_nyuuryokusuru⟧⟦ください→下さい：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: When you register, please enter a nickname of your choice.

examples.japanese: ⟦{小学校|しょうがっこう}→小学校：01055_shougakkou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{時|とき}⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{今|いま}→今：00945_ima⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{同|おな}じ→同じ：02857_onaji⟧ニックネーム⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{呼|よ}ばれている→呼ぶ：00766_yobu⟧。
examples.english: I have been called by the same nickname since elementary school.

notes:
A loanword from English "nickname." Widely used in both face-to-face and online contexts, and often appears as a form field label on websites alongside the user's real name.

USAGE:
- In everyday conversation, ニックネーム refers to informal names used among friends or within a group.
- On Japanese websites, apps, and games, the ニックネーム field is the public-facing display name, distinct from the real name (⟦{本名|ほんみょう}→本名：13034_honmyou⟧).
- Parents and teachers also use ニックネーム or ⟦あだ{名|な}→あだ名：10211_adana⟧ to describe the nicknames that children give each other.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ニックネーム⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦つける→つける：00562_tsukeru⟧: to give (someone) a nickname
- ニックネーム⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{呼|よ}ぶ→呼ぶ：00766_yobu⟧: to call (someone) by their nickname
- ニックネーム⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{決|き}める→決める：00858_kimeru⟧: to decide on a nickname
- ニックネーム⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{登録|とうろく}する→登録する：25227_tourokusuru⟧: to register a nickname (online)
- ⟦かわいい→かわいい：00857_kawaii⟧ニックネーム: a cute nickname

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦あだ{名|な}→あだ名：10211_adana⟧: nickname / moniker — more traditional Japanese word, often used for school-age nicknames
- ⟦{愛称|あいしょう}→愛称：12678_aishou⟧: pet name / term of endearment — emphasizes affection, also used for affectionate names for products or places
- ⟦{本名|ほんみょう}→本名：13034_honmyou⟧: real name — the opposite of ニックネーム
- ⟦ハンドルネーム→ハンドルネーム：29587_handoruneemu⟧: handle name — specifically an online/internet pseudonym (wasei-eigo, not standard English usage)
